name: EGTimeZone
description: Olson timezone name to POSIX TZ rule for ESP8266/ESP32. Names are never stored: a zone is 21 bits of FNV-1a hash and an offset into a deduplicated rule blob, so all 597 IANA zones including backward aliases cost under 4 KB of flash and no heap. Tables are generated from a pinned IANA tzdb by tools/gen_timezones.py, never hand-edited.
keywords: timezone, tz, olson, iana, ntp, esp8266, esp32
